seo.description: Learn about Typhoid Fever — symptoms, causes, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention tips.

overview: Typhoid fever is a bacterial infection caused by Salmonella Typhi, spread through contaminated food and water. It remains endemic in parts of India. Prompt diagnosis and appropriate antibiotics prevent serious complications.
symptoms: Headache, abdominal pain, and constipation or diarrhoea
causes: Salmonella Typhi infection via faecal-oral route
Poor hand hygiene in endemic settings
riskFactors: Consumption of untreated water or raw foods
Lack of typhoid vaccination in high-risk individuals
diagnosis: Blood culture (gold standard early in illness)
Clinical correlation with travel and exposure history
treatment: Appropriate antibiotics (azithromycin, ceftriaxone, or fluoroquinolones per local resistance patterns)
Hospitalisation for severe cases or complications
Carrier state may need prolonged treatment
prevention: Typhoid vaccination before travel or in endemic settings
Eat well-cooked food; avoid raw salads from unknown sources

faqs.question: What causes Typhoid Fever?
faqs.answer: Multiple factors including genetics, lifestyle, and environment contribute.

faqs.question: Is Typhoid Fever curable?
faqs.answer: Many conditions are manageable with proper treatment. Consult your doctor for prognosis.
